d: Ilektrik vahan, saur oorja, semikandaktar aur aadhunik taknik ke vistar ke sath bharat men tanba yani kopar ki mang teji se barh rahi hai. aane vale varshon men yah mang kaee guna barhne ka anuman hai. aise men desh ke samne sabse bari chunauti gharelu khanan kshamta barhane aur aayat par nirbharta kam karne ki hai. isi disha men hindustan kopar limited (echsiel)ne apni khanan kshamta ko agle tin varshon men char lakh tan se barhakar 12.2 lakh tan karne ka lakshy nirdharit kiya hai.
